_about: Things to find out in the world (scripts/explore.gd, 2026-11-26, docs/REVIEW_2026-11-26.md section 6). patches: lush green patches of turf with a faint glint; dug with the shovel (a click with it in hand, or the patch's own menu) they give one roll of their loot table: [id, x, z, table, refill days (0 = once only)]; a patch is moved to the nearest open ground when the world is built. Its 'note' is shown instead of the usual line. loot: tables of [kind, a, b, weight]: coins a..b, an item a (id) times b, or a pair of found needles a (once: a pair she has is coins instead). Coins found are not sweater money, so the ledger leaves them out. needles: pairs found out in the world; the best she owns sets the least a sweater can be, like Rosa's (empire.needle_floor()). huts: little buildings with a chest each (opened once): at [x, z], yaw in degrees, the chest's loot as a list of [kind, a, b]. waders: Steve's, for the deep water round the Deep Mire (regions.gd: the grid's moat opens once she has them). tent: Steve's; pitched from the ground ring anywhere open outside town; sleeping in it with a bonfire of hers within fire_radius fills every bar, without one it gives rest energy like sleeping by a fire. Both are for sale once Act 1 is done. Every line, name, place and number is a DRAFT.

waders.line: Chest waders. Rubber, the real thing. Mind the Mirewood: past the reeds it's deeper than it looks.

tent.line: Canvas tent, poles, pegs, the lot. Pitch it by a good fire and you'll sleep like a log.

notes.gran_first: Under the turf, a biscuit tin in Gran's handwriting: "For a rainy day, love. There are more of these about. Keep your eyes on the grass."
